Deprecated: use WFO.spelling.check()

Source: R/acceptable.R
WFO.acceptable.match.Rd

WFO.acceptable.match() (from WorldFlora) returns TRUE when the submitted and matched names are identical or differ only by common misspellings, i.e. when WFO.spelling.check() gives "identical" or "spelling corrected". It is kept for compatibility and will be removed in a later version.

Usage

WFO.acceptable.match(x, spec.name = "spec.name", no.vowels = FALSE)

Arguments

x

Results of WFO.match() or WFO.one().

spec.name

Name of the column with the submitted names.

no.vowels

If TRUE, also treat differences in vowels as misspellings.

Value

A logical vector (NA where no name was matched).
